name: wiki
description: Outside-knowledge wiki under .llmwiki/: facts about what the repo does not control (platforms, vendors, customers, the domain), kept as untouched originals in raw/ and concept pages with a ## Sources section in wiki/. ingest (a source document or a fact learned while working into concept pages, updates index.md and log.md, scaffolds the wiki on first use, turns decisions, terms and repeated mistakes away to docs/adr, GLOSSARY.md and /retro), query (cited answers from index -> pages -> raw, saves a new answer only after approval), lint (stale pages, broken links and Sources, orphans, index drift), plaud-note-taking (PLAUD Whisper transcript correction into .llmwiki/raw/transcripts/, hands facts to ingest). No hooks, no scripts.
